title: update_quality_filter params
description: Set minimum quality thresholds for catalog display.

min_resolution.description: Hide catalog items below this resolution. 'unknown' means no filter.

min_bitrate_bucket.description: Hide items below this bitrate bucket.

hide_possible_upscale.description: If true, hide items flagged possible_upscale=true.

content_types.description: Restrict catalog to these content types.
